title: Nine Men in a Row
subtitle: 战争与和平 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）
meta: 主题语境：战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）　|　核心词汇：army　|　正文 313 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 army 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1943 my grandfather joined ① an army he could not have found on a map and came home in 1946. The ② army, meaning the men and not the generals, was nine hundred in his camp and forty by the spring; an army, he said, is a crowd that has agreed on a time. He said the agreeing was the whole of it and the time was never his.

Every ③ army he ever saw moved at the same speed, which is the speed of the slowest man in it. Their ④ army had one cook and nine rules, and he said the rules lasted longer than the cook; an army, my father said, is the only organisation that feeds you before it believes you. He said that was not kindness but arithmetic.

My grandmother raised ⑤ an army of cousins to pick the fruit in 1955, nine of them, and paid them in bread. The ⑥ army, meaning the institution and not the men, is the only thing that outlives everybody who joins it; an army, he said, is a machine made of people who are waiting to leave. He said the waiting was the engine.

By 1968 the  army had become the word he used for anything with too many people in it. The  army of letters she wrote that winter came to nine hundred words and one answer; an army, my mother said, is any large number of things that arrive together and cannot be sent back. She said the answer arrived in March.

The ⑦ army I remember is the one in the photograph, nine men in a row, four of whom he could not name. An ⑧ army, he said in 1974, is the only thing that is counted in thousands and remembered in ones; every army, he said, is a list that somebody else keeps. He said he had never once seen the list.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 军队；部队（一支具体的军队）
B. n. 军队（指那些士兵，与将军相对）
C. n. 军队（指照片里那一排人）
D. 固定搭配：join an army 参军
E. n. 一大群；一大批（比喻义）
F. n. 军队（指这个机构、制度）
G. n. 军队（抽象总称；泛指）
H. n. 军队（他们的、那支部队）

items.q: an army he could not have found on a map
The army, meaning the men and not the generals

answers.why: join an army 意为“参军”，1943 年祖父参了一支他在地图上都找不到的军，1946 年回了家。
army 指“那些士兵”，与将军相对，他的营地里有九百人，到春天只剩四十。
army 意为“军队、部队”，他见过的每一支军队都以同样的速度行进，也就是其中最慢那个人的速度。
army 指他们那支部队，他们那支部队有一个厨子和九条规矩，他说规矩比厨子活得久。
an army of 意为“一大群、一大批”，1955 年祖母动员了一大群表亲来摘果子，一共九个，用面包付工钱。
army 指“这个机构、制度”，与士兵相对，它是唯一比所有加入它的人活得都久的东西。
army 指照片里那一排人，我记得的是照片上那九个人排成一排，其中四个他叫不出名字。
army 为抽象总称，泛指“军队这种东西”，他说军队是唯一以千计数、却被一个个记住的事物。
